text: DSH 侧栏收纳（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把侧栏面板图标整理到可折叠的「更多」入口，让新会话、工作区和面板区域按更清晰的顺序排列。它通过客户端槽位注册入口与设置页，并用 CSS 调整图标行顺序和折叠显示。用户可选择整行悬停、悬停「更多」或点击展开，也能逐项将图标移出折叠组，并在点击模式选择记忆开合状态。适合希望侧栏更简洁、又想保留常用面板快捷入口的 DSH Web 用户；无需额外密钥或外部账号，偏好保存在浏览器 localStorage。

DSH Sidebar Tidy (DSH plugin, Web client): groups panel icons under a collapsible More row and reorders them around workspaces. Settings offer hover, label-hover, or click expansion, plus switches to keep selected icons visible. Preferences stay in browser localStorage; no API key is read.

DSH 侧栏收纳 的功能「展开方式设置」：在「侧栏收纳」设置页选择整行悬停、悬停「更多」文字附近或点击展开，也可记忆点击模式的开合状态；各面板入口还能逐项设为不折叠。

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 安装：1. 把本仓库放到任意目录，例如 `~/dsh-plugins/dsh-sidebar-tidy`。
2. 链进 profile 的 `node_modules`：
   - Windows：`mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-sidebar-tidy" "C:\path\to\dsh-sidebar-tidy"`
   - macOS / Linux：`ln -s ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-sidebar-tidy ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-sidebar-tidy`
3. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 里登记两处：
   - `dependencies` 增加 `"dsh-sidebar-tidy": "link:<源码目录>"`
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 增加 `"dsh-sidebar-tidy"`
4. 刷新页面即可生效（实测 desktop profile 无需重启；若个别环境未收录，重启一次 DeepSeek Harness）。
dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 卸载：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 移除该行，重启 DeepSeek Harness 即可。插件卸载时会移除自己插入的样式表、侧栏属性、事件监听与设置页；`dsh-sidebar-tidy:*` 这几个 `localStorage` 键可以手动清掉，留着也不影响其它功能。

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 实现方式（为什么这么轻）：DSH 侧栏没有「排序槽」——兄弟元素的先后由 shell 写死，第三方也不能注销别人的注册项。所以本插件不改 DOM 结构，只用三招：

1. **CSS `order` 挪位**：侧栏根节点是 flex column，`regionArea`（工作区）设 `order:20`、`panelList`（面板图标）`order:30`、`footArea`（底部）`order:40`，图标就排到了工作区下方。
2. **`display: contents` 拆掉图标组的外壳**：`nav[class*="_panelList"]` 设成 `display:contents` 后，它里面的每一行都变成侧栏 flex 容器的直接子元素，于是可以**逐行**给 `order` —— 被移出的行 `order:15`（回到新会话下方），组里其余行仍是 `order:30`。
3. **`display:none` 折叠**：`html[data-dsh-sidebar-tidy="folded"]` 时，隐藏图标组里除本插件入口行、以及被移出的行以外的所有行。
section: 实现方式（为什么这么轻）

text:
dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 实现方式（为什么这么轻）：「哪个开关对应哪一行」得由插件自己认：侧栏的行没有任何 id 属性，所以它读 `ctx.slots.entriesOfSlot('sidebar.panellist')` 拿到 `{id, order, label}`，先按行的 `aria-label` 文本对号、再按 `order` 顺序补齐，然后把 `data-dsh-tidy-id` / `data-dsh-tidy-keep` 写到行上；行被重建（切换 `wide`、重挂载）后会在下一次 `syncAttr` 里重新标记。

入口按钮本身走客户端槽位 API 正常注册（`ctx.slots.inject('sidebar.panellist', () => ctx.slots.register({...}))`），因此主题、hover、选中高亮全部跟随原生样式；入口行还必须拦掉侧栏默认的 `selectPanel(id)` 行为（该 id 没有对应的 main 面板）。
section: 实现方式（为什么这么轻）

text:
dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 实现方式（为什么这么轻）：设置页走 `settings.section` 槽另注册一个整页（`id: sidebar-tidy`），因此它和 DSH 自带的设置页并列显示，不需要改任何 shell 代码。

**失败安全**：所有侧栏 CSS 选择器都以 `html[data-dsh-sidebar-tidy]` 打头，而这个属性只有在**自检确认真实侧栏 DOM 就位**（`nav[class*="_panelList"]`、`div[class*="_regionArea"]`、`div[class*="_footArea"]` 同时存在）之后才会写入。DSH 内部类名漂移时，插件只会「不生效」，不会把界面改坏；选择器本身用 `[class*="_panelList"]` 这类子串匹配，抗小版本改名。
section: 实现方式（为什么这么轻）

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 环境与验证：- 已在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows，desktop profile）** 实机验证：悬停展开 / 移开折叠（含 220ms 延迟）、键盘焦点开合、折叠态提示点、中英文文案与 `title` 提示、设置页里的**三方案切换**、**「悬停『更多』」的命中区**（指针扫过行内其余位置不展开、移到「更多」文字上才展开、点整行也能展开、窄轨道只剩图标时照样可展开）、「记住展开状态」跨刷新保持、**逐个入口移出折叠区**（移出的行回到新会话下方、悬停时不再触发展开、选择跨刷新保持）、卸载后页面完全复原。
- 与 `dsh-claude-style` 皮肤共存正常（该皮肤不触碰侧栏 `_*` 布局类，也不对这些元素设 `order`）。注意它会把 `sidebar.footer.action` / 设置行压成 0×0，所以本插件的入口刻意放在 `panelList` 末行，而不是侧栏底部槽位；设置页仍可正常打开（皮肤只是把入口挪进了自己的账号浮层）。
- 若另有插件替换了整个 `sidebar` 槽（`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`），侧栏结构会完全不同，本插件会因自检不通过而静默不生效。

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · 兼容性注意：- 侧栏内部的 `_XXXXXX_*` 类名属于 DSH 内部实现；上游若改布局类名，需要更新 `lib/client.js` 顶部的 `SEL_*` 常量（改一处即可）。
- 「移出折叠区」依赖 `display: contents`：如果上游给图标组加了会新建包含块或裁剪的样式（`transform` / `filter` / `overflow` / `contain`），逐行挪位可能失效；此时插件仍会正常折叠，只是移出不起作用。
- 只处理 `sidebar.panellist` 里的面板图标；`sidebar.footer.action`、设置行等其它入口保持原位。
- 设置页只占 `settings.section` 槽里的一个条目（`id: sidebar-tidy`，`order: 100`），插件被禁用时该页一起消失，不会影响其它设置页。

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · What it does：| State | Sidebar, top to bottom |
| --- | --- |
| Collapsed (default) | Brand row → New session → **Workspaces (session list, fills the remaining space)** → "⋯ More" → footer user/settings row |
| Expanded (hover mode, default) | Brand row → New session → **Workspaces (session list)** → Plugins / Schedules / Context Insights / Usage stats / Skills + "More" → footer user/settings row |
| Hover “More” (optional) | Same as above; it expands only when the pointer comes near the “More” label (or the icon beside it) — sweeping the rest of the row does nothing — and clicking anywhere on the row expands it too |
| Expanded (click mode, optional) | Same as above; the entry row reads "Collapse" while open |
| Entries kept outside (optional) | The entries you tick move back **below New session, above Workspaces**; the rest stay in the "More" group |

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · What it does：- **Moving the pointer onto the "⋯ More" row expands it in place; moving away folds it back** (no popover). The fold is delayed by 220 ms so a grazing pointer does not make it flicker.
- Want a different trigger? **Settings → Sidebar tidy → Expansion mode** switches between **three** schemes at any time (see the next section): the whole row on hover, only the “More” label (clicking the row works too), or click to toggle.
- Want an entry to skip the group entirely? **Settings → Sidebar tidy → Entries kept out of the group**, one switch per entry (see the section after that).
- Keyboard users: focusing the entry row (Tab) expands it, losing focus folds it back.
- While collapsed, if a hidden panel is the currently selected one (`aria-current="page"`), a small dot appears on the entry icon.
- Labels follow the DSH locale: "更多" in Chinese, "More" in English; the `title` tooltip follows the scheme ("Hover to expand · move away to fold", "Hover the “More” label to expand · clicking the row works too", or "Click to expand or collapse").

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · Three expansion schemes (Settings → Sidebar tidy)：| Scheme | Interaction | State memory |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Hover** (default) | Expands as the pointer enters, folds about 0.2 s after it leaves; clicking the row changes nothing | Not remembered — a reload starts collapsed |
| **Hover “More”** | Expands only when the pointer comes near the “More” label (and the icon beside it, padded by 6 px each way); sweeping the rest of the row does nothing. **Clicking anywhere on the row expands it too** | Not remembered — a reload starts collapsed |
| **Click** | Click the "More" row to expand / collapse; its label flips between "More" and "Collapse" | Optional: with "Remember the expansion state" on, the state survives a reload |

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · Three expansion schemes (Settings → Sidebar tidy)：- Switching happens inside **Settings → Sidebar tidy** (a segmented control) and takes effect immediately — no restart needed.
- The choice itself lives in `localStorage["dsh-sidebar-tidy:mode"]` (`hover` / `label` / `click`); when remembering is on, the open/closed state lives in `dsh-sidebar-tidy:click-open`.
- The page is drawn with DSH's own UI primitives (`SegmentedControl` / `Switch`); if that package cannot be resolved it falls back to self-drawn controls, so the feature still works.
- The default state (no `localStorage` at all) is exactly the 0.1.1 behaviour: hover to expand, nothing remembered.

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · Keeping entries out of the group (Settings → Sidebar tidy)：- The lower part of the same page is **"Entries kept out of the group"**: the panel icons that currently exist in the sidebar are listed one by one. Turn a switch on and that row **leaves the group** and returns to its original place — **below New session, above Workspaces**; turn it off and it goes back into "More".
- A kept-out row stays visible in both the collapsed and the expanded state, and it does **not** take part in hover expansion: sweeping the pointer over it never springs the group open (it is no longer part of that group).
- Each row states its current status: "Outside the group (below New session)" or "Folded into the icon group".
- The list follows the sidebar's slot: if you install a plugin that adds a panel icon at runtime, it shows up here too (refreshed when the settings page redraws; no reinstall of this plugin needed).
- The selection lives in `localStorage["dsh-sidebar-tidy:keep"]` as a JSON array of slot entry ids, e.g. `["plugins"]`.

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · How it works (and why it is this small)：The DSH sidebar has no "ordering slot" — sibling order is hard-coded by the shell, and a third-party plugin cannot unregister other plugins' entries. So this plugin never touches the DOM structure; it only uses three tricks:
section: How it works (and why it is this small)

text:
dsh-sidebar-tidy README · How it works (and why it is this small)：1. **Reordering with CSS `order`** — the sidebar root is a flex column: `regionArea` (workspaces) gets `order:20`, `panelList` (panel icons) `order:30`, `footArea` (footer) `order:40`, which moves the icon row below the workspaces.
2. **Dissolving the icon group with `display: contents`** — with `nav[class*="_panelList"] { display: contents }` every row inside it becomes a direct flex item of the sidebar column, so each row can carry its **own** `order`: a kept-out row gets `order:15` (back below New session) while the rest of the group stays at `order:30`.
3. **Collapsing with `display:none`** — under `html[data-dsh-sidebar-tidy="folded"]`, every row of the group except the plugin's own entry row and the kept-out rows is hidden.
section: How it works (and why it is this small)

text: dsh-sidebar-tidy README · How it works (and why it is this small)：Which switch maps to which row is the plugin's own problem to solve: sidebar rows carry no id attribute at all, so it reads `ctx.slots.entriesOfSlot('sidebar.panellist')` for `{id, order, label}`, matches rows by their `aria-label` text first and by `order` afterwards, and then writes `data-dsh-tidy-id` / `data-dsh-tidy-keep` onto the rows; after the rows are rebuilt (wide toggle, remount) the next `syncAttr` re-marks them.
section: How it works (and why it is this small)

text: dsh-sidebar-tidy README · How it works (and why it is this small)：The entry button itself is registered through the normal client slot API (`ctx.slots.inject('sidebar.panellist', () => ctx.slots.register({...}))`), so theming, hover and active highlighting all come from the native styles; the entry row also intercepts the sidebar's default `selectPanel(id)` behaviour, because that id has no matching main panel.
section: How it works (and why it is this small)

text: dsh-sidebar-tidy README · How it works (and why it is this small)：The settings page is a second registration into the `settings.section` slot (`id: sidebar-tidy`), so it simply appears next to DSH's own settings pages — no shell changes required.
section: How it works (and why it is this small)

text: dsh-sidebar-tidy README · How it works (and why it is this small)：**Fail-safe by design**: every sidebar CSS selector is prefixed with `html[data-dsh-sidebar-tidy]`, and that attribute is written only after a self-check confirms the real sidebar DOM is present (`nav[class*="_panelList"]`, `div[class*="_regionArea"]`, `div[class*="_footArea"]`). If DSH renames its internal classes, the plugin simply does nothing instead of breaking the UI. Selectors match class *substrings*, so small renames do not matter.

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · Verified environment：- Verified on a live **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (Windows, desktop profile)**: hover-to-expand / move-away-to-fold (including the 220 ms delay), keyboard focus open/close, the collapsed-state dot, localized labels and tooltip, **all three schemes** in the settings page, **the “Hover “More”” hit box** (sweeping the rest of the row does nothing, moving onto the label expands, clicking anywhere on the row expands, and the icon-only rail still expands), the "remember" switch surviving a reload, **keeping individual entries out of the group** (the row returns below New session, hover no longer springs the group open, and the choice survives a reload), and a clean rollback after uninstall.
- Coexists with the `dsh-claude-style` skin (it neither touches the sidebar layout classes nor sets `order` on them). Note that the skin collapses `sidebar.footer.action` / the settings row to 0×0, which is why this plugin's entry lives in the last row of `panelList` instead of a footer slot; the settings page still opens normally (the skin merely moves its launcher into its own account popover).

dsh-sidebar-tidy README · Compatibility notes：- The `_XXXXXX_*` classes inside the sidebar are DSH internals; if upstream renames the layout classes, update the `SEL_*` constants at the top of `lib/client.js` (one place).
- Keeping entries out relies on `display: contents`: if upstream adds a property that creates a containing block or clips (`transform` / `filter` / `overflow` / `contain`) on the icon group, the per-row reordering may stop working — collapsing still works, the "keep out" part just has no effect.
- Only the panel icons in `sidebar.panellist` are touched; `sidebar.footer.action`, the settings row and other entries stay where they are.
- The settings page occupies a single `settings.section` entry (`id: sidebar-tidy`, `order: 100`); disabling the plugin removes that page and nothing else.
